messages:
Julian: heads-up thread for next-week webinar ops. need owners for reg page copy (incl. EU consent), Zoom recording fallback, HubSpot routing, and who owns clip gating.
Anya: I can own Zoom and the backup flow. plan: cloud recording to org folder + local host recording + OBS RTMP to s3 as redundant copy. will run RTMP smoke test in greenroom.
Marta: Ill map HubSpot fields and build the nurture: reminder (24h), day-of (2h), replay (4h), 7-day follow-up. need a separate list for benchmark opt-ins.
Gabe: Ill draft announcement + three clip scripts (15s, 45s, 90s). prefer clip 1 within 24h, then stagger. will add small demo CTA overlay.
Legal: Consent must be explicit opt-in. propose two lines selectable by user: (1) "I consent to follow-up emails and marketing materials." (2) "I consent to short video highlights being used for marketing." include privacy link.
Julian: good. make sure consent properties are stored: marketing_consent and highlights_consent with timestamps. Marta, can you also capture country for GDPR gating?
Marta: yes. add country -> contact.country and consent timestamps -> marketing_consent_ts. For EU cookies/processing, block bulk marketing if consent false.
Anya: runbook snippet for greenroom: start OBS RTMP, start cloud recording, start local host recording, run 10s caption sync test (say "caption test"), confirm SRT export. on failure: upload local file to s3 and trigger speech->text job (whisper-large).
Gabe: replay page plan: gated PDF + "Request a live demo" CTA that creates a HubSpot task for SDRs. clips will have embedded meeting link for quick bookings.
Julian: lead scoring & handoff: Hot = attended + demo click OR attended + benchmark_opt_in -> assign SDR task; Warm = attended >50% or interacted -> nurture + SDR alert; Cold = registered no-show -> standard drip. Marta will implement.
Marta: will create workflows and test with staging contact. also add property webinar_session -> "inference-ops-apr2026".
Legal: put consent strings and privacy link in Legal channel for sign-off by EOD Tue.
Anya: ZoomBot will post recording link after event; I'll verify SRT and move files to marketing/webinars/apr-2026/ then ping for clip editing.
Gabe: final ask: can we add a short survey in the replay email for benchmark participants? 3 questions max so we get quick pass/fail signals.
Julian: yes, add lightweight survey and route responses to growth for quick analysis. greenroom scheduled 30m prior. thanks everyone :rocket:
